dict.string: Menubench uses Automation to move files in Finder, send items to the Trash and open Terminal commands when you ask for Homebrew actions.
Menubench taps individual app audio only to adjust each app's volume in the mixer. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Menubench uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Menubench shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Menubench organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose.

Menubench checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose.
